title: Run suite2p
description: Runs suite2p (registration, cell detection, signal extraction and deconvolution) on the stack, when the suite2p package (0.x or 1.x) is installed, and saves its cells as ROIs, and their signals and spikes, in the same variables as the native methods. suite2p's own output is kept in a suite2p folder next to the ROI file. Its options are passed to suite2p under suite2p's names (given in each option's description), with suite2p's defaults; of a stack with channels or planes, suite2p gets the channel and plane chosen.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

rois.title: ROIs
rois.description: Variable the cells are saved to as ROIs.

output.title: Signals
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

neuropilOutput.title: Neuropil signals
neuropilOutput.description: Variable the neuropil signals are saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

spikesOutput.title: Spikes
spikesOutput.description: Variable suite2p's deconvolved spikes are saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

onlyCells.title: Keep only what suite2p classifies as cells

tau.title: Indicator decay time (s)
tau.description: suite2p's tau, for deconvolution: about 0.7 for GCaMP6f, 1.0 for GCaMP6m, 1.25-1.5 for GCaMP6s

registration.title: Register the frames
registration.description: suite2p's do_registration; turn it off for a stack that is aligned already

nonrigid.title: Nonrigid registration
nonrigid.description: suite2p's nonrigid: blocks of the frame are registered on their own after the rigid shift

sparseMode.title: Sparse mode
sparseMode.description: suite2p's sparse_mode (in suite2p 1.x the sparsery detection algorithm; off, sourcery)

thresholdScaling.title: Threshold scaling
thresholdScaling.description: suite2p's threshold_scaling: higher finds fewer ROIs, lower more

maxIterations.title: Most detection iterations
maxIterations.description: suite2p's max_iterations (in suite2p 1.x, sourcery's, with sparse mode off)

spatialScale.title: Spatial scale
spatialScale.description: suite2p's spatial_scale, in sparse mode: 0 finds it, 1 is 6 pixels, 2 12, 3 24, 4 48

denoise.title: Denoise before detection
denoise.description: suite2p's denoise: the binned movie is denoised by PCA before cells are found, in sparse mode

neuropilCoefficient.title: Neuropil coefficient
neuropilCoefficient.description: suite2p's neucoeff: the share of the neuropil taken from the signal before deconvolution

innerNeuropilRadius.title: Gap to the neuropil (px)
innerNeuropilRadius.description: suite2p's inner_neuropil_radius: pixels between a cell and its neuropil

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Of a stack with channels (height x width x channels x frames): the one to use, from 1

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a stack with planes (height x width x channels x planes x frames): the one to use, from 1
